items.name: akso-tokens
items.title: Akso UI color tokens
items.description: Color tokens checked against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, for light and dark mode. Installed automatically with every Akso UI component.

items.name: akso-styles
items.title: Akso UI shared styles
items.description: Button and focus ring styles shared by Akso UI components. Installed automatically.

items.name: akso-form
items.title: Akso UI form helpers
items.description: Field context, a shared polite live region for announcements, and a submit marker. Used by Field, Input, Textarea and Form. Installed automatically.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible button built on Base UI. Visible focus ring, 44px targets, and a loading state that keeps focus and is announced by screen readers.
items.docs: Akso UI Button: icon-only buttons need an aria-label. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Accessible modal dialog built on Base UI. Traps focus, closes with Escape, returns focus to the trigger, respects reduced motion and works at 320px wide.
items.docs: Akso UI Dialog: always include a <DialogTitle>. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, description and error messages for a form control, linked for screen readers. Shows required fields as text and announces errors as they appear.
items.docs: Akso UI Field: every field needs a FieldLabel; write clear messages with <FieldError match="...">. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field for use inside Field. 44px tall, 16px text, visible focus ring and an invalid state that does not rely on color alone.
items.docs: Akso UI Input: use it inside <Field> with a <FieldLabel>, and set type and autoComplete. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field for use inside Field, with the same accessible states as Input.
items.docs: Akso UI Textarea: use it inside <Field> with a <FieldLabel>. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related fields under a legend that screen readers announce when focus enters the group.
items.docs: Akso UI Fieldset: always include a FieldsetLegend. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form that validates its Fields, moves focus to the first error on submit and announces how many fields need attention.
items.docs: Akso UI Form: use it with Field; translate the message with invalidMessage. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
